job.job_description:
E Software Solutions (ESS) is looking for a creative and analytical Prompt Engineer to design, test, and optimize prompts for AI models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other Large Language Models (LLMs).
The candidate will work closely with teams to improve AI-generated responses, enhance automation workflows, and support AI-driven projects.
The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of AI/ML concepts, strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and an interest in prompt engineering and emerging AI technologies.
